Body.DeclarationsIntro: Declarations take effect according to their content and receipt; processing is not a legal precondition. Resolve unverified cases promptly and monitor pending confirmations and dates.
Body.MarkDeclarationProcessedHint: Review the full declaration and original agreement evidence. An email match alone does not prove identity. Processing never changes receipt time.
Body.DeclarationEffectiveEndHint: end date confirmed to the declarant
Body.ImmediateReview: Review immediately: original receipt and requested date govern. Reconcile later debits and preserve paid access.
Body.DeclarationActionHint: Scheduling targets the original current renewal agreement under its period rules, with no new consent or retrospective debit. External handling records actions already taken and a sent response; it makes no automatic account change. Document deviations, late processing, restitution review and communication.
Body.DeclarationVerified: Identity and contract sufficiently verified; original receipt, effect and verified communication evidence recorded in the note.

Commercial.title: Commercial cases
Commercial.intro: Inspect retained case observations and existing originals. These reads do not determine a claim or execute a payment.
Commercial.authentication: A current administrator session with verified second factor is required.
Commercial.liveQueue: This is a changing queue of up to 100 cases per page. Cases can move between pages; an empty page does not establish that every review is complete.
Commercial.emptyQueue: No cases were returned for this page.
Commercial.subject: Original claimant
Commercial.rawDetail: The exact received export text can contain large numbers and sensitive evidence. Amounts below come from the separate exact capacity read; these reads are not a joint snapshot.
Commercial.capacityLimit: This purchase ceiling is not a cash entitlement or a payment approval. Unknown history is not zero; other service rights may remain relevant.
Commercial.knownSelector: Enter an exact known reference. This is not a document inventory. A missing or unavailable response does not establish that no historic original existed.

errors.authority: Current coherent staff authentication is not confirmed. Sign in or deliberately load again after checking the session.
errors.missing: No accessible original was returned for this exact selection.
errors.malformed: The selection or returned data does not match the supported contract.
errors.unavailable: The read is not confirmed. Keep the reference and deliberately retry later.

basis.live_original_claimant_capture_records: Basis: current capture records of the original claimant.
basis.preserved_original_claimant_erasure_obse: Basis: preserved original claimant erasure observation.

prior.operator_reviewed: Earlier refund basis was reviewed by an operator.

HoldReview.title: Review existing retention holds
HoldReview.intro: Record a reasoned decision to keep one existing hold. This action does not release or delete records, settle claims or execute payments.
HoldReview.live: This is a live queue. Records can move, repeat or disappear between pages; a page is not a complete inventory.
HoldReview.empty: No rows were returned for this page.
HoldReview.exhausted: No further row was observed after this page. This does not mean all reviews are complete.
HoldReview.subject: Original claimant
HoldReview.latest: Latest recorded review of this hold
HoldReview.noReview: No human review is recorded for this hold identity. Its installation identity does not date the original record.
HoldReview.date: Next review date, including time and timezone
HoldReview.dateHint: For example: 2026-12-01T10:00:00+01:00. Enter a concrete date yourself. The server decides whether a new review date is in the future.
HoldReview.scope: I have reviewed the entire selected existing hold and choose to keep it with the assessment and next review date entered above.
HoldReview.local: Saved requests are kept in this browser. Different tabs may show different pending requests. Keep each unresolved request and recover it using the account that originally created it.
HoldReview.exact: Review the original command below. Recovery keeps its actor, record identity, assessment and date unchanged, even if the live queue changes.
HoldReview.retryHint: An exact retry can record the original review for the first time or retrieve its existing receipt. It is not a read-only status check. No retry happens automatically.
HoldReview.localHistory: The saved file contains local receipt history. Imported history is not fresh server confirmation.
HoldReview.receipt: The server confirmed this exact review command.
HoldReview.historyOnly: This receipt is historical evidence. It does not prove the hold still has this version or date. Reload the live queue explicitly to observe current records.

errors.authority: Current staff authority is unavailable. Sign in with the appropriate staff account, then explicitly load or retry. Saved commands are preserved.
errors.storage: Saved data could not be read or verified. No command was sent. Keep your recovery file.
errors.unavailable: The queue could not be confirmed. This is not an empty queue.
errors.prepare: The review could not be prepared. Check the selected hold, assessment, explicit timezone and storage.
errors.pending: An unresolved command for this hold is already saved. Recover that exact command before preparing another local decision.
errors.import: The file could not be imported as an exact saved review. Existing commands are preserved.
errors.actor: Only the original staff account can retry this command. The command remains saved unchanged.
errors.unconfirmed: The outcome is not confirmed. Keep the original command and use explicit exact retry; do not assume no change occurred.
errors.receiptStorage: The exact receipt was received, but could not be saved reliably. The original pending command is retained; keep its recovery file.

Determination.title: Determine a pending obligation
Determination.intro: Review one existing obligation and record a determination. This does not pay or reserve money.
Determination.unitsHint: Amounts use the recorded integer units: 100 units = 1 EUR. Enter whole units without separators; unknown and zero are different.
Determination.subject: Original claimant
Determination.selectCase: Select an existing case below to prepare a new determination. Saved command recovery remains available here.
Determination.cashKnown: I am entering an explicit cash amount and its basis
Determination.cashBasis: Basis for the cash amount (at least 20 characters)
Determination.confirm: I have reviewed this obligation and the amounts and evidence entered above.
Determination.notPending: This observation is not pending evidence. It cannot prepare a new determination. Existing command history can still be recovered.
Determination.local: These records are stored in this browser. Other tabs may have different views; separate commands are preserved.
Determination.pending: Original command; no confirmed history here
Determination.unsupported: Raw history outside this supported format
Determination.keepOriginalFile: Keep the original file. It was not rewritten or admitted for replay.
Determination.uncertain: This original may already have been sent. An absent history observation or an error does not prove that nothing happened.
Determination.claimed: A file contains claimed receipt history; that alone is not fresh server confirmation.
Determination.sendHint: Submitting or retrying is deliberate and uses the original actor and exact saved body. A retry can first apply a command that never arrived. No replacement command is created automatically.
Determination.serverHistory: Stored journal JSON, not original HTTP bytes
Determination.noJournal: No matching journal was observed in this read. Keep the original command; its outcome is not settled by this absence.
Determination.receipt: Original determination receipt confirmed: established, not paid. Current obligation state is shown separately.
Determination.receiptUnsaved: The response was confirmed, but its receipt could not be saved locally. Keep this original and recover its history; do not infer that a new command is safe.

errors.authority: Verify the current enabled staff account and MFA before reading or submitting. Saved originals remain available.
errors.import: This file could not be admitted as a supported command. Its contents are available for local inspection only.
errors.storage: The saved record could not be read or verified. Preserve the original file.
errors.missing: The exact target was not available in this read. This does not resolve the command’s outcome.
errors.unavailable: The current observation is unavailable or malformed. No conclusion about a command’s outcome follows.
errors.prepare: Check the selected pending obligation, whole-unit amounts, assessment and confirmation. No command was submitted.
errors.pending: A saved command for this obligation has no confirmed history here. Inspect or recover that exact original first.
errors.actor: Only the original staff actor can retry this command. Do not alter the actor or body.
errors.unconfirmed: No confirmed response is available. Preserve and recover this exact original; do not create an automatic replacement.
errors.history: The observed journal cannot be qualified against this supported original actor and body. Inspect its raw history; uncertainty remains.
errors.receiptStorage: The original receipt was confirmed but could not be saved. Preserve the original command.

RetentionPage.title: Retained record lists
RetentionPage.intro: Read one page of existing records in a selected category. These lists also include records whose review date is in the future.
RetentionPage.exhausted: This read has no further page.
RetentionPage.empty: No rows were returned for this page.
RetentionPage.liveHint: Records can change between pages and move ahead of or behind the cursor. Rows may repeat or be missed; restart when needed.
RetentionPage.observationHint: An empty or last page does not establish that all records were reviewed. Reading these observations does not authorize access to originals or disposal.

errors.authority: Current staff access with MFA is required. Sign in or verify the session, then read the first page explicitly.
errors.malformed: The page request or cursor was rejected. Restart from the first page.
errors.unavailable: This page is unavailable. No current result is shown; restart explicitly when ready.
